privacy.centerSubtitle: Manage your personal data, consent choices, statutory rights, and grievances under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.effectiveDate: Effective: September 2026 • DPDP Act 2023 & DPDP Rules 2025
privacy.dpoAddress: Privacy & Compliance Cell, Driving License Form, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382010
privacy.dpoSla: All grievances are acknowledged within 24 hours and addressed within statutory timelines.
privacy.whyAskThis: Why do we ask for this?
privacy.whyAskAadhaar: Required under Motor Vehicles Act for identity verification and biometric duplicate prevention. Masked in system.
privacy.whyAskMobile: Used for two-factor authentication, security alerts, and statutory status updates. Never shared with marketers.
privacy.whyAskDob: Required by law to ensure the applicant satisfies statutory age requirements for the requested vehicle class.
privacy.whyAskAddress: Determines local RTO jurisdiction and delivery of printed Driving Licence smart card.
privacy.minorConsentDesc: As per Section 9 of the DPDP Act 2023, personal data of minors can only be processed with verified consent of the lawful parent or guardian. Behavioral profiling and targeted advertising are strictly prohibited.
privacy.guardianConsentCheck: I am the lawful parent/guardian and hereby give verifiable consent for processing the minor's application data.
privacy.exportDesc: Download a complete, machine-readable JSON copy of all personal records, applications, documents metadata, and consent history associated with your account.
privacy.correctionDesc: Notice incorrect information? Submit a formal correction request under Section 12 of the DPDP Act 2023.
privacy.erasureDesc: Request deletion and irreversible anonymization of your account and personal data. Deletion is subject to statutory retention checks and absence of active legal holds.
privacy.erasureWarning: Warning: Erasure permanently revokes account access, anonymizes past application records, and purges uploaded identity documents once verified.
privacy.mandatoryNotice: Statutory Mandatory Processing — Required to process your driving licence application under the Motor Vehicles Act.
privacy.optionalNotice: Optional Service — You may grant or withdraw this consent at any time without affecting your licence application.
privacy.policyHeroSubtitle: Learn how Driving License Form collects, uses, protects and manages your personal information.
privacy.summaryWhyWeUseDesc: How your data supports the service
privacy.managePrivacySubtitle: View your data, manage consent choices, and submit statutory privacy requests directly from your Privacy Center.
privacy.needHelpSubtitle: You can contact our dedicated Data Protection Officer or submit a privacy grievance through our Privacy Center.
